text.en:
Bintang Temasek
(the Star of Temasek) Rules 1996
The President is pleased to approve the institution of a Decoration to be styled the Bintang Temasek or the Star of Temasek, the award of which shall be governed by the following Rules:

THE SCHEDULE
Rule 7.
The Star of Temasek
OBVERSE
REVERSE
